reason: A offers the more physically plausible and testable mechanism—Al–Ni chemical affinity driving B2 ordering and FCC/B2 partitioning—with a controlled cooling-rate comparison, baseline, boundaries, and falsification criterion. Its cited studies are only indirect and its ordering measurements should include superlattice diffraction or atom-probe/TEM methods, but B is circular about an undefined “optimal” Al content, lacks evidence, and implausibly assumes that maximizing SRO simultaneously improves every target property.
